scores.rationale: Phases go from decisions to single-user editor to sync to persistence to auth to collaboration UX. Convergence tests gate later work, and auth comes before presence and comments.

scores.evidence: Milestone: two browsers edit the same document and converge.
scores.rationale: A thin end-to-end slice appears only in Phase 2, after a full single-user editor. No production deployment or CI path is in Phase 0.

scores.evidence: CRDTs are easier for offline support and peer-to-peer. The cost is metadata growth.
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are listed up front with tradeoffs. There is no explicit default or flip condition, and the plan leaves the choice open.

scores.evidence: Put this before the social features, because presence and comments depend on knowing who the user is.
scores.rationale: Some ordering puts wide-impact work first, such as convergence tests and schema before features. Within phases it is not reasoned, and Phase 1 puts the toolbar before persistence.

scores.evidence: Security: rate limiting, input and update validation, payload size caps, and protection against malicious or malformed updates.
scores.rationale: Security is mostly a Phase 7 trailing step. Only auth in Phase 4 comes earlier, and Phases 0 to 3 have no security treatment.

scores.evidence: Observability: metrics for sync latency, connection counts, and update sizes, plus error tracking.
scores.rationale: Observability is placed in Phase 7 hardening, not from day zero.
The plan says nothing about reproducible builds, environments, CI or infrastructure as code.

scores.evidence: Handle reconnection and resync, and make applying an update idempotent.
scores.rationale: Resilience appears in Phase 2 (reconnect, idempotency), Phase 3 (durable log) and Phase 5 (offline), but not in every phase. Flaky-network testing and DR drills come late.
The plan never says whether an AI layer applies, so it does not earn the N/A credit.

scores.evidence: Phase 8: Polish and scale ... Slash commands, embeds, tables, and images with an upload pipeline.
scores.rationale: Later work is placed in Phase 8, but there are no pull-forward conditions and no explicit statement of what is deferred.

note: The plan has sound dependency ordering and a good convergence-test gate. Security, observability, reproducibility and a Phase 0 production skeleton are missing or come late, and it never says the AI layer is N/A.
